units: <cite ref="Gittin 56b:15">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>בא י׳ ונכנס וכ׳</he> a mosquito came and entered his (Titus’) nose; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:7">Gen. R. s. 10</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 22:3">Lev. R. s. 22</cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 77b:6">Sabb. 77ᵇ</cite> <he>י׳ לנחש</he> the mosquito (an application of a pulp made of mosquitos) is a remedy for a serpent’s bite.
Ib. אימת י׳ על הפיל the fear which the elephant has of the yattush, v. אֵימָה.
Snh. 38ᵃ; Lev. R. s. 14, beg. י׳ קדמך וכ׳ the y. has been created before thee (man); a. e.—Pl. יַתּוּשִׁים, יַתּוּשִׁין.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 5:9">Gen. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 3:17">Gen. III, 17</cite>) <he>דברים ארורים כגון י׳ ופרעושין וכ׳</he> cursed things like gnats, fleas and flies; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 12:4">Tosef. Sabb. XII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 13:4">XIII</cite>), 4 <he>זבובין וי׳</he>; Y. ib. XIV, beg. 14ᵇ <he>ותושין</he> (corr. acc.), v. <cite ref="H00145"><he>חָגָז</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: a bug (on a fruit). Sifra Sh’mini Par. 10, ch. XII; Ḥull. 67ᵇ; a. e., v. כָּלִיס.
